# Continue clicking magenta to move W toward G
seg = current_frame.segmentation
mag_pos = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M':
        b = n['boundary']
        mag_pos = (b[0][0], b[0][1])
        break

print(f"Magenta at: {mag_pos}")

# Click magenta several times to trace the path
for i in range(4):
    if mag_pos:
        result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': mag_pos[0], 'col': mag_pos[1]}])
        
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        w_pos = g_positions = []
        for n in seg['nodes']:
            if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] >= 5:
                b = n['boundary']
                rows = [p[0] for p in b]
                cols = [p[1] for p in b]
                w_pos.append(f"{n['color']}(px={n['pixels']}):({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)})")
            if n['color'] == 'G' and n['pixels'] >= 10:
                b = n['boundary']
                rows = [p[0] for p in b]
                cols = [p[1] for p in b]
                g_positions.append(f"{n['color']}(px={n['pixels']}):({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)})")
            if n['color'] == 'M':
                b = n['boundary']
                mag_pos = (b[0][0], b[0][1])
        
        print(f"After click {i+1}: done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
        for p in w_pos:
            print(f"  {p}")
        for p in g_positions:
            print(f"  {p}")
        
        if last_action_result.get('done'):
            print("Level completed!")
            break
